6900.meaning1: not mentally established; not stable in mind
6900.notes: obviously a wrong reading, see CDB note 69

examples.text: cakkhunā kho pan'eva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto adīnamānaso abyāpannacetaso.

6903.synonym: akappiya, akalla, ananucchavika, anānuloma, abhadraka, asāruppa

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, santuṭṭhā bhavissāma itar'ītarena cīvarena, itar'ītara-cīvara-santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādino, na ca cīvarahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjissāma.
vigarahi buddho bhagavā, ananucchavikaṃ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.

6904.meaning1: not agreeable; disrespectful; not polite; not obedient
6904.commentary: (VINa) appatissā'ti appatissavā. upāsakā'ti vutte vacanam'pi na sotu'kāmā, anādarā'ti attho. appatissayā vā anīcavuttino'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, kimila, tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appatissā, dhamme agāravā viharanti appatissā, saṅghe agāravā viharanti appatissā, sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appatissā, samādhismiṃ agāravā viharanti appatissā, appamāde agāravā viharanti appatissā, paṭisanthāre agāravā viharanti appatissā.

6905.meaning1: not agreeable; disrespectful; not polite; not obedient

6906.meaning2: not to be turned or rolled back; not to be black; irresistible
6906.commentary: (ANa) taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyan'ti taṃ tena evaṃ pavattitaṃ āṇācakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ hoti.

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rājā cakkavattī dhammen'eva cakkaṃ vatteti, taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appativattiyaṃ kenaci manussabhūtena paccatthikena pāṇinā.

6909.commentary: (VIN 1.2.8) appatīto'ti tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti

ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ, āpattiṃ āpanno'ti. jānanti maṃ bhikkhū āpattiṃ āpanno'ti, iti so kupito hoti appatīto. yo c'eva kho, āvuso, kopo yo ca appaccayo, ubhayam'etaṃ aṅgaṇaṃ.

6910.meaning1: not reached; not attained; not gained; not accomplished; not found

examples.text: sekhassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅgan'ti karitvā n'āññaṃ ek'aṅgam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bah'ūpakāraṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikāro.
veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā, n'atthi me pubben'āparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanābalan'ti.

6911.grammar: nt, pp of na pāpuṇāti, neg
6911.meaning1: unattained; unaccomplished; which has not been reached

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya vīriyaṃ ārabhatha appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.

6913.meaning1: not fulfilled one's intention; not achieved one's goal; (comm) not attained arahantship

examples.text: sekhassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅgan'ti karitvā n'āññaṃ ek'aṅgam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bah'ūpakāraṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikāro.
yo'pi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sekkho appattamānaso anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamāno viharati, so'pi pathaviṃ pathavito abhijānāti, pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññāya pathaviṃ mā maññi

6914.meaning1: not yet reached twenty years of age

examples.text: ūnavīsativasso nāma appattavīsativasso.

6915.commentary: (DNt) app'atthataro'ti pana ativiya appakicco, attho c'ettha kiccaṃ, ttha-kārassa ṭṭha-kāraṃ katvā app'aṭṭhataro'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: atthi pana, bho gotama, añño yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'atthataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti?

6916.grammar: abs of na pāpuṇāti, neg, trans (+acc)
6916.meaning1: having not reached; having not arrived (at)
6916.construction:
na > a + pa + √ap + tvā
na + patvā

examples.text: gamanena na pattabbo, lokass'anto kudācanaṃ, na ca appatvā lok'antaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.
so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.

6917.meaning1: lacking stamina; without endurance; with no staying power
6917.commentary: (SNa) appathāmako'ti ñāṇathāmassa parittatāya parittathāmako. (NIDD1a) appathāmakā'ti appo paritto thāmo etesaṃ vāyāmo ussāho'ti appathāmakā.

examples.text: akkandati parodati, dubbalo appathāmako, na so pātāle paccuṭṭhāsi, atho gādham'pi n'ājjhagā.

atha vā, abalaṃ puggalaṃ dubbalaṃ appabalaṃ appathāmakaṃ hīnaṃ nihīnaṃ omakaṃ lāmakaṃ chatukkaṃ parittaṃ, yassa n'atthi saddhābalaṃ vīriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ.

6918.meaning1: who does not understand correctly; who grasps in the wrong way
6918.meaningLit: not grasping with the right hand
6918.commentary: (VINa) yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ appaṭipajjanato padakkhiṇena anusāsaniṃ na gaṇhātī'ti appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ. (MNa) ayaṃ anusāsaniṃ padakkhiṇato na gaṇhāti, vāmato gaṇhāti, tasmā appadakkhiṇaggāhī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: pavāreti ce'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu, vadantu maṃ āyasmanto, vacanīyo'mhi āyasmantehī'ti, so ca hoti dubbaco, dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato, akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ
bhikkhū pan'eva dubbacajātiko hotī'ti dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.

6919.meaning1: who has little vision; with limited understanding
6919.meaning2: of little vision; of little knowledge
6919.commentary: (NIDD2) appadasse pahāyā'ti yo ca bāvarī brāhmaṇo ye c'aññe tassa ācariyā buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ upādāya appadassā parittadassā thokadassā omakadassā lāmakadassā chatukkadassā vā. (SNPa) appadasse'ti bāvaripabhutike parittapaññe.

examples.text: dijo yathā kubbanakaṃ pahāya, bahupphalaṃ kānanam'āvaseyya, evaṃ p'ahaṃ appadasse pahāya, mah'odadhiṃ haṃso'r'iva ajjhapatto.

6920.commentary: (PMa) anibbiddhapubban'ti anamatagge saṃsāre antaṃ pāpetvā anibbiddhapubbaṃ. appadālitapubban'ti tass'eva atthavacanaṃ, antakaraṇen'eva apadālitapubban'ti attho.

examples.text: so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti

6921.meaning1: with no light; without a lamp
6921.commentary: (VINa) appadīpe'ti padīpacandasūriyaaggīsu ekenā'pi anobhāsite. ten'ev'assa padabhājane, anāloke'ti vuttaṃ.

6922.meaning1: living a mildly difficult life; (comm) living in suffering just because of a minor mistake

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto app'ātumo appadukkhavihārī.
abyāpannacitto hoti appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo ime sattā averā hontu abyāpajjā anīghā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantū'ti
yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa, tam'eva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ'va khitto.
yo daṇḍena adaṇḍesu, appaduṭṭhesu dussati, dasannam'aññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ, khippam'eva nigacchati.

6925.meaning1: not angry; not offended; not upset

examples.text: te n'ātivelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni nappadūsenti. te aññam'aññaṃ appaduṭṭhacittā akilantakāyā akilantacittā.

6926.meaning1: who abuses an innocent; who wrongs the blameless
6926.commentary: (SNa) tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti… appaduṭṭhapadosī puggalo, taṃ puggalaṃ kammaṃ phusantam'eva kammaṃ phusati, vipāko vā phusati.

examples.text: n'āphusantaṃ phusati ca, phusantañ'ca tato phuse, tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti.

6927.meaning1: with no malevolent intention; with no bad purpose in mind; with no evil designs

examples.text: abyāpannacitto kho pana hoti appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo, ime sattā averā abyābajjhā anīghā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantū'ti.

6929.grammar: pp of na padhaṃsati, in comps, neg (+instr)
6929.meaning1: not attacked; not assaulted; not violated (by)

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? appadhaṃsiyo hoti abbhantarehi vā bāhirehi vā paccatthikehi paccāmittehi, rāgena vā dosena vā mohena vā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.

6931.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from appeti, caus
6931.meaning2: fixing of thought on an object, attainment of a trance
6931.notes: The occurrence of appanā the Suttapiṭaka is unusual, the sequence of synonyms normally only occurs in Abhidhamma.

examples.text: yo kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā vacīsaṅkhāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo ariyo anāsavo lok'uttaro maggaṅgo.
taṃ nimittaṃ āsevantena bhāventena bahulīkarontena mettāya vuttanayen'eva tikacatukkajjhānavasena appanā vaḍḍhetabbā.

6932.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from appeti, caus

6933.commentary: (VISM) paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo'ti ādivacanato pana yā parikamm'ānantarā ek'aggatā, ayaṃ appanāsamādhī'ti evaṃ upacārappanāvasena duvidho.

examples.text: tesaṃ kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ? upacārasamādhi kusalavīthiyaṃ javitvā bhav'aṅgaṃ otarati, appanāsamādhi divasabhāge appetvā nisinnassa divasabhāgam'pi kusalavīthiyaṃ javati, na bhav'aṅgaṃ otarati. imesu dvīsu samādhīsu nimittapātubhāvena upacārasamādhinā samāhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
yāni ca kho tāni sen'āsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi sen'āsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī'ti
brāhmaṇatissabhaye pana bhātaragāmavāsino nāgattheriyā anārocetvā'va palāyiṃsu. therī paccūsasamaye ativiya appanigghoso gāmo, upadhāretha tāvā'ti daharabhikkhuniyo āha.

6935.meaning1: with little food, drink, or possessions

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

6936.meaning1: unthinkable; which cannot be proliferated about; which cannot be conceptualized
6936.commentary: (ANa) appapañcaṃ papañcetī'ti na papañcetabbaṭṭhāne papañcaṃ karoti, anācaritabbaṃ maggaṃ carati.

examples.text: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth'aññaṃ kiñcī'ti, iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti.

6937.meaning1: lacking in wisdom; low in intelligence
6937.commentary: (MNa) tass'appapañño'ti tassa tādisassa appapaññassa añño appapañño abhisaddahanto. (SNa) appapaññan'ti nippaññaṃ.

examples.text: upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ, saṃsāram'āpajja param'parāya, tass'appapañño abhisaddahanto, upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ.
giriduggacaraṃ chetaṃ, appapaññaṃ acetasaṃ, akāle ovadaṃ bhikkhu, mando'va paṭibhāti maṃ.
catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito'ti vuccati. katamehi catūhi?

6939.meaning1: with a small retinue; with a tiny circle

examples.text: ajātā nāma pathavī, suddhapāsāṇā suddhasakkharā suddhakaṭhalā suddhamarumbā suddhavālikā appapaṃsukā appamattikā, yebhuyyenapāsāṇā, yebhuyyenasakkharā, yebhuyyenakaṭhalā, yebhuyyenamarumbā, yebhuyyenavālikā.

6941.commentary: (VINa) appapāsāṇ'ādīsu appā pāsāṇā etthā'ti appapāsāṇā'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: jātā nāma pathavī, suddhapaṃsu suddhamattikā appapāsāṇā appasakkharā appakaṭhalā appamarumbā appavālikā, yebhuyyenapaṃsukā, yebhuyyenamattikā.

6942.meaning1: with little merit; having no spiritual wealth

examples.text: lābhī c'amhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appapuññā app'esakkhā na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānan'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.

6944.meaning2: with few men, with few males

6945.meaning1: of little fruit; yielding negligible results

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti.
so catassannaṃ parisānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi appabaddhehi anusayasamugghātāya. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.
viññāṇaṃ pabhaṅgu. yo tassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅ'gamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgū'ti.
etha tumhe, āvuso, appabhassā hotha, bhasse pariyantakārino'ti, iti bhassapariyante samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā.

6949.commentary: (VINt) appabhikkhuko'ti katipayabhikkhuko. tadā kira bhikkhū yebhuyyena majjhimadese'y'eva vasiṃsu, tasmā tattha katipayā eva ahesuṃ. te ca ekasmiṃ gāme eko, ekasmiṃ nigame dve'ti evaṃ visuṃ visuṃ vasiṃsu.

examples.text: sammaggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa appabhītassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
appabhogo mahātaṇho, khattiye jāyate kule, so ca rajjaṃ patthayati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco daliddo hoti appassako appabhogo. evarūpo, bhikkhave, aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati.

6952.meaning1: fact of having little wealth; poorness

examples.text: iti kho, māṇava… app'abhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appabhogattaṃ upaneti, mahābhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahābhogattaṃ upaneti, nīcakulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā nīcakulīnattaṃ upaneti, uccākulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā uccākulīnattaṃ upaneti

6953.meaning1: leading to being poor; conducive to having little wealth

examples.text: app'abhogasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyy'āvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.

6954.grammar: prp of na pamajjati, neg, pass, intrans
6954.meaning1: not being careless; not being negligent; being vigilant

examples.text: ye me pavutte siṭṭhipade, anusikkhanti jhāyino, kāle te appamajjantā, na maccuvasagā siyun'ti.

6956.grammar: fem, abstr, from na pamāṇa, neg
6956.meaning1: immeasurable state of mind; epithet of the four divine dwellings
6956.meaning2: infinitude, measureless state; technical term including four qualities of mind, viz. love, pity, sympathy, and disinterestedness
6956.construction:
na > a + pa + √mā + aṇa + yā
appamāṇa + yā
6956.commentary: (THa) phusissaṃ catasso appamaññāyo'ti appamāṇagocaratāya appamaññā'ti laddhavohāre cattāro brahmavihāre phusissaṃ phusissāmi, kālena kālaṃ samāpajjissāmi.

examples.text: phusissaṃ catasso appamaññāyo, tāhi ca sukhito viharissaṃ, n'āhaṃ sītena vihaññissaṃ, aniñjito viharanto'ti.
yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihassati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatī'ti.
appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.
appamatto ayaṃ gandho, yv'āyaṃ tagaracandanaṃ, yo ca sīlavataṃ gandho, vāti devesu uttamo.
appamatto ayaṃ kali, yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo, sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā, ayam'eva mahantataro kali.

6960.synonym: aṇu, aṇuka, aṇuparimita, anu, appa, appamatta, oramattaka, khudda, khuddaka, thoka, thokaka, parittaka

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appamattakam'pi pāpakammaṃ kataṃ tam'enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
etadeva, bhante, bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ mahāpathavī. appamattako'yaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.

6961.grammar: nt, in comps, comp, from appamatta

examples.text: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo
appamattakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ yadidaṃ, byañjanaṃ. m'āyasmanto appamattake vivādaṃ āpajjitthāti.

6962.meaning1: distributor of insignificant items; who gives out small items; sundries dispenser

examples.text: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo

upasampannassa saṅghena sammatassa sen'āsanapaññāpakassa vā bhatt'uddesakassa vā yāgubhājakassa vā phalabhājakassa vā khajjabhājakassa vā appamattakavissajjakassa vā cīvaraṃ dinne khiyyati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

6963.meaning1: state of attentive understanding; fact of having vigilant wisdom

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā appamattapaññatā saṃvattantī'ti.
sakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, ambaṭṭha, sakyānaṃ yadidaṃ kapilavatthuṃ, n'ārahat'āyasmā ambaṭṭho imāya appamattāya abhisajjitun'ti.
ye rāgadosavinayā, avijjāsamatikkamā, sekkhā apacay'ārāmā, appamatt'ānusikkhare, te namassāmi mātalī'ti.

ajātā nāma pathavī, suddhapāsāṇā suddhasakkharā suddhakaṭhalā suddhamarumbā suddhavālikā appapaṃsukā appamattikā, yebhuyyenapāsāṇā, yebhuyyenasakkharā, yebhuyyenakaṭhalā, yebhuyyenamarumbā, yebhuyyenavālikā.

6968.grammar: adj, comp, fem nom sg of appamattaka
6968.synonym: aṇu, aṇuka, appa, appamatta, appamattaka, oramattaka, khudda, khuddaka, thokaka, parittaka

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ bhogaparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.
jātā nāma pathavī, suddhapaṃsu suddhamattikā appapāsāṇā appasakkharā appakaṭhalā appamarumbā appavālikā, yebhuyyenapaṃsukā, yebhuyyenamattikā.

6971.commentary: (ANa) appamāṇenā'ti vaḍḍhitappamāṇena. (ANa) appamāṇo samādhī'ti catubrahmavihārasamādhi'pi maggaphalasamādhi'pi appamāṇo samādhi nāma

examples.text: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.
dasa'y'imāni, bhikkhave, kasiṇ'āyatanāni. katamāni dasa? pathavīkasiṇam'eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.

6972.meaning1: with immeasurable mind; with unrestricted mind
6972.commentary: (MNa) appamāṇacetaso'ti appamāṇaṃ lok'uttaraṃ ceto assā'ti appamāṇacetaso, maggacittasamaṅgī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso

6973.meaning1: with immeasurable perception; having limitless awareness
6973.meaning2: of immeasurable perception; with limitless awareness

examples.text: parittasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ paraṃ maraṇā, appamāṇasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ paraṃ maraṇā

6974.meaning1: immeasurable meditative composure; boundless stability of mind

examples.text: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.

6975.meaning1: of immeasurable beauty; epithet of a class of devas

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇasubhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇasubhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

6976.meaning1: living a life beyond measure; epithet of an arahant; (comm) living unlimited (by lust etc.)
6976.commentary: (ANa) appamāṇavihārī'ti khīṇ'āsavass'etaṃ nāmam'eva. so hi pamāṇakarānaṃ rāg'ādīnaṃ abhāvena appamāṇavihārī nāma.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahatto appamāṇavihārī.

6977.meaning1: of immeasurable radiance; epithet of a class of devas
6977.commentary: (DNa) majjhimaṃ bhāvetvā upapannā appamāṇ'ābhā nāma honti, tesaṃ cattāro kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ.

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇ'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇ'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
idha pana, gahapati, ekacco appamāṇ'ābhā'ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇ'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

6980.meaning1: not according to the correct measurement; not of the right size; over-sized
6980.construction:
na > a + pa + māṇā + a + ika
appamāṇa + ika
6980.commentary: (VINa) appamāṇikāyo'ti ettakena niṭṭhaṃ gacchissantī'ti evaṃ aparicchinnappamāṇāyo, vuddhippamāṇāyo vā mahantappamāṇāyo'ti attho.

6981.grammar: masc, abstr, from na pamajjati, neg
6981.meaning1: alertness; care; carefulness; caution; vigilance; diligence; conscientiousness; heedfulness

examples.text: appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.
appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike'ti.

6983.meaning1: fact of having respect for heedfulness

examples.text: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā, ime kho, bhante, cha dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti. idam'avoca sā devatā.

6985.meaning2: Chapter 11 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
6985.meaningLit: section on carefulness with elided repetitions

6986.meaning1: fruit of diligence; result of heedfulness; consequence of alertness

examples.text: imaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno appamādena karaṇīyan'ti vadāmi.

6987.meaning1: due to diligence; through heedfulness; by means of alertness
6987.meaning2: due to diligence; through heedfulness; by alertness

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.

6988.meaning1: rooted in carefulness; stemming from heedfulness; originating from alertness
6988.commentary: (SNa) appamādena hi te paṭilabbhanti, tasmā so tesaṃ aggo. ten'etaṃ vuttaṃ sabbe te appamādamūlakā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.

6989.meaning1: delighting in diligence; devoted to conscientiousness; taking pleasure in alertness
6989.commentary: (DHPa) appamādarato'ti appamāde rato abhirato, appamādena vītināmento'ti attho.

examples.text: appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, saṃyojanaṃ aṇuṃ thūlaṃ, ḍahaṃ aggī'va gacchati.
appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike'ti.

6990.meaning1: converging upon carefulness; coming together in heedfulness; merging in alertness

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.

6991.meaning1: accomplishment of conscientiousness; achievement of vigilance; successful alertness

examples.text: sīlasampannass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ… yadidaṃ, chandasampadā… yadidaṃ, attasampadā… yadidaṃ, diṭṭhisampadā… yadidaṃ, appamādasampadā…

6996.meaning2: Chapter 10 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

6997.meaning2: Chapter 7 of the Satipaṭṭhānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

6998.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Sammappadhānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

6999.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Balasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
